description: This file defines the SafeAnalysisNodeVisitor class, which implements node visiting logic for analyzing safety of nodes in Twig templates, including handling of expressions, filters, functions, and safety propagation.

classes.name: SafeAnalysisNodeVisitor
classes.description: Implements node visiting for safety analysis in Twig templates, managing safe variables and propagating safety information through nodes.

methods.name: setSafeVars
methods.description: Sets the list of safe variables.

methods.name: getSafe
methods.description: Retrieves safety information for a given node.

methods.name: setSafe
methods.description: Assigns safety information to a node.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Called when entering a node; currently returns the node unchanged.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Analyzes and propagates safety information when leaving a node, handling various expression types.

methods.name: intersectSafe
methods.description: Computes intersection of safety arrays, considering 'all' as universal safety.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the visitor, set to 0.
